mapper.select: SELECT a.*, f.name AS folder_name FROM knowledge_articles a LEFT JOIN knowledge_folders f ON f.id = a.folder_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_articles (title, content, folder_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{folderId}, datetime('now'), datetime('now'))
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_articles SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, folder_id = #{folderId}, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
